notes.title: 0.97 Update. New Arcade Mode
notes.content:
1. Join the new Arcade Mode, abandon distractions, and enjoy the chaotic world of challenges. Challenge the speed limit! Now we are also a racing game~~~
2. More levels will be updated for the Arcade Mode in the future, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 0.96 notes. Added 3 new movement modes to DBall!
notes.content:
1. Added three new movement modes to DBall, each offering a distinct control feel: Agile, Smooth, and Clumsy (original mode). The Agile mode significantly reduces game difficulty and is highly recommended for trying out! 
[b]Setting->Ball Control[/b]

2. Updated and upgraded all UI elements, saying goodbye to the bare-bones look~~~ Thanks to Epic's free resources (Lyra)~~

3. Updated some sound effects, replacing harsh tones with more elegant ones.

4. Fixed various minor bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470638/6b620ff1beb32f2d3effd80eca27ed85fc70825f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470638/ca11bfffc0a0082db37f417cf9587107459fff1f.jpg[/img]
